checks.detail: Reviewed candidate-bound runtime, interface, persistence, security, and visual evidence against the PRD. All four bound receipts show fresh npm+cargo builds exit 0, native launch titled Focusboard, embedded assets, product/diagnostic separation pass, and an attributable validation error with input preserved. The changed surface (focusboard:// deep link) is implemented in code: session desktop-entry scheme registration, warm Unix-socket forwarding, cold argv handling, and auto-verify that never renders the token; the new capability grants only core:event:default and the CSP in tauri.conf.json is untouched per the change manifest. Security review: Argon2 hashing, SHA-256-hashed single-use expiring tokens, sign-in rate limiting, enumeration-safe errors, parameterized SQL, versioned WAL schema. Both bound screenshots match the section 9.1 auth direction with no prohibited patterns. Residual items are pre-existing evidence/style debts (rustfmt diff, uncaptured signed-in views, hijacked white-box lane); no new product defect found in the changed surface. Caveat: no bound receipt exercises the deep link at runtime; tracked under prd_golden_path and find.deeplink-scheme-not-registered.

The release-critical PRD section 3 path is neither complete nor fully verified. Focus, Calendar, and Settings render deferred placeholder surfaces and the command/SQLite surface has no reminder, focus-session, or calendar entities, so steps 6 (reminder time/timezone), 7 (calendar placement), 8 (focus session), and 10 (reminder email) cannot be performed. For the completable portion, every bound receipt reports observed.golden_path.state=unavailable ('golden-path probe element not present in the renderer'); register, mail-sink verification, sign-in, quick-add, and restart were never driven through the live UI/IPC boundary, and bound pixel evidence covers only the auth shell plus its validation state. The registered white-box lane (focusboard-verify) remains unreachable behind the import-time runpy hijack, so neither the black-box nor the white-box drive requirement is met; store-level cargo tests cover route logic only. gap:prd_golden_path stays unverified and the criterion fails.

developer_outcome.summary: Warm and cold external focusboard:// activations exercised natively against mail-sink messages under Xvfb: OS routing resolved to focusboard.desktop, warm activation returned to the running app and consumed the token once, cold link-launch booted into the verified state, reuse stayed recoverable. State observed via app SQLite DB and process liveness; pixel captures remain the host webdriver gate.

risk_note.summary: OS-level scheme registration is environment-dependent (dev session versus bundled desktop-entry contexts), so the likeliest insufficient_evidence outcome is a replay that cannot prove an external link activation returned to the application.
risk_note.validation: Native replay drives an external focusboard:// activation (warm and cold) against the local mail-sink message and captures the resulting application state; a unit-test-only pass must not be reported as runtime success.
risk_note.why_now: find.deeplink-scheme-not-registered is this loop's single active, host-pinned product finding and gap:prd_golden_path is unverified, leaving the release-critical first-run path with a known literal gap.
